Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching event management companies in Bangladesh, and Look N Feel Event Solutions came up as a player in the corporate and wedding event space. The biggest leak in event businesses is usually in enquiry response time — couples and corporate clients message multiple event planners simultaneously, and the one who replies fastest with the most relevant package wins.

Here's what I see: booking is phone/WhatsApp-only, and every enquiry requires manual back-and-forth about event type, guest count, venue, and budget. During peak season, your team is drowning in enquiries, and leads go cold when replies take more than a few hours.

I built an AI event consultant agent that handles WhatsApp/Instagram enquiries 24/7 — it asks about event type, guest count, preferred dates, and budget range, then provides instant package recommendations and books a consultation with your planning team. It also sends automated follow-ups to clients who enquired but didn't book.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
